Remarks:
Both units of power plant CHP-2 are  separately qualified to provide balancing capacity services to the TSO and will participate in the Baltic balancing capacity market starting from February 5, 2025, 00:00 CET. 

The TSO's acceptance of capacity bids from power plant CHP-2  will result in submitting non-price-forming orders in the Day-Ahead auction and limiting sell volume in the amount of allocated capacity by the TSO. 

Units are unavailable for BBCM during start-up. Simultaneous bid from both units to BBCM is not available.
